overview_description.description: Rydezilla is a Dubai-based mobility technology company specializing in digital car rental solutions, vehicle booking services, and fleet management software. Founded in 2017, the platform enables users to rent cars, motorcycles, and other vehicles through a seamless mobile and web-based experience. Rydezilla also provides SaaS tools for rental companies, including booking automation, fleet tracking, branch management, and customer service support. The company operates primarily in the Middle East and has expanded through partnerships such as its collaboration with Udrive Bahrain to enhance digital car rental accessibility in the region.

about_short_description.short_description: Rydezilla provides a digital platform and mobile app for vehicle rentals and fleet management systems.

product.name: Rydezilla Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that connects users with vehicle rental offices and sellers for searching, booking, and listing vehicles.

product.name: Rydezilla Dealer App
product.description: A mobile application for vehicle dealers to list and manage their rental vehicles and bookings on the Rydezilla platform.

product.name: Cloud-based Vehicle Management System
product.description: A cloud-hosted system for fleet owners to add vehicles, track locations, monitor expenses, and manage rental operations.

product.name: Online Car Rental Booking Service
product.description: An online service that allows users to search, select, and book rental vehicles with options for extras and payment through the Rydezilla Platform.

product.name: Vehicle Listing and Classifieds Service
product.description: A platform feature allowing individuals and dealers to post and advertise vehicles for sale or rent, visible to other users.
